note: Game Reference Gate (v3): per-Q1 design traceability. reference_games are the proven games whose PRINCIPLES (not skins) each Q1 borrows; chain = JOB DIFFICULTY -> PRINCIPLE -> MECHANIC -> PLAYER ACTION -> WORLD FEEDBACK -> MASTERY. Sources: factory/taxonomy/mechanics-library.json evidence_games.

borrowed_design_principles: document-vs-object inspection under a mistake budget
one-item-at-a-time judgment queue with hidden violations
transformed_for_job: passport rules -> today's collection rules (day type rotates)
contraband -> hazardous items (spray cans/batteries) with a mechanical fire consequence
stamp choices -> load / violation sticker / bag sticker / hazard call
curb_check.why_it_is_fun: each bag is a small whodunit against a rotating rulebook; the black-bag blur adds info pressure
curb_check.what_requires_skill: cross-referencing bag look with today's rules; knowing when NOT to load
curb_check.why_replay: bags, day type and violations re-randomize; perfect run = zero mistakes
curb_check.trace: hazard/irreversibility -> inspection-queue principle -> measurement_inspection -> per-bag 4-way call -> bag loads/sticker appears/truck fire ends day -> fewer mistakes per street

borrowed_design_principles: spatial resource juggling under throughput pressure
keep a system balanced, not a single task done
transformed_for_job: kitchen orders -> incoming waste loads of differing wetness
plate delivery -> feeding the incinerator a HOMOGENEOUS mix (850C rationale)
pit_crane.why_it_is_fun: grid juggling: every turn the pit changes, and greedy feeding backfires
pit_crane.what_requires_skill: reading the 3x3 grid state and mixing BEFORE feeding
pit_crane.why_replay: load sequences re-randomize; expert = stable burn all 8 turns
pit_crane.trace: fuel homogeneity duty -> spatial juggling principle -> spatial_placement/resource_allocation -> mix/feed choices on a grid -> grid cells + burn meter shift -> stable-burn streaks

borrowed_design_principles: evidence elimination under a hard time budget
asking the RIGHT authority matters more than acting fast
transformed_for_job: wrong accusation -> wrong team dispatched while the real cause reaches the stack
gas_watch.why_it_is_fun: a 3-suspect mystery where every check costs a time slot
gas_watch.what_requires_skill: choosing checks that SPLIT the remaining causes (information value)
gas_watch.why_replay: cause and meter values re-randomize; expert = 2-check triage
gas_watch.trace: alert triage duty -> elimination-under-time principle -> evidence_elimination + time budget -> check picks then one request -> time pips burn, cause chips strike out -> 2-check mastery

borrowed_design_principles: small daily choices compound into system health
transformed_for_job: line expansion -> cell allocation for typed intake (ash/incombustible)
nightly covering duty + leachate tank as the compounding system
landfill_ops.why_it_is_fun: a tiny management sim: today's shortcuts visibly bite tomorrow
landfill_ops.what_requires_skill: placement concentration (less exposed face) + weather-aware cover priority
landfill_ops.why_replay: intake + weather re-randomize; expert = 5 clean days, low complaints
landfill_ops.trace: duty-vs-throughput -> compounding-sim principle -> resource_allocation -> place loads + choose covers -> cells fill, tank/complaint meters move -> clean-week mastery

borrowed_design_principles: daily judgment against slowly drifting data
care loop where overreaction is a real error class
transformed_for_job: document stamps -> ok/adjust/consult triage from the growth CURVE + diary
pet care -> professional husbandry: single dips are noise, patterns are signal
baby_care.why_it_is_fun: reading a living curve like a detective: is today noise or signal?
baby_care.what_requires_skill: trend-vs-single-number discrimination; combining curve shape with diary flags
baby_care.why_replay: 12+ week layouts, benign dips punish panic; perfect week = 5/5 calls
baby_care.trace: trend triage duty -> daily-judgment principle -> trend_reading -> 3-way call each morning -> curve grows + mentor nudge on miss -> mistake-free weeks

transformed_for_job: final accusation -> one-shot treatment plan; restraint = 12% aborted day, gated behind 2 observations
zoo_checkup.why_it_is_fun: diagnosing without touching: burden budget makes every probe a real choice
zoo_checkup.what_requires_skill: choosing checks that change the plan; burden economy
zoo_checkup.why_replay: 3 causes re-randomize; expert = diagnosis at burden <=1
zoo_checkup.trace: low-burden ladder -> cost-weighted elimination -> evidence_elimination + resource_budget -> pick checks then one plan -> burden bar fills, cause chips die -> burden-1 mastery

borrowed_design_principles: assemble orders against a spec under resource constraints
the spec interacts with today's tickets (no memorized answer)
transformed_for_job: recipes -> the daily ration table applied to TODAY's weigh-in and nursing memo
limited ingredients -> veg stock arithmetic with lactation priority
feed_prep.why_it_is_fun: a pantry puzzle where the same table yields a different correct breakfast every morning
feed_prep.what_requires_skill: rule x data derivation + stock counting + priority reasoning
feed_prep.why_replay: weigh-in straddles the milk line, stock varies; perfect = zero redos
feed_prep.trace: rules-x-data duty -> spec-assembly principle -> rule_application + resource_budget -> tray building -> trays fill, senior silently points at a wrong tray -> first-serve mastery

borrowed_design_principles: plan under uncertainty, then adapt to live events
withdrawing can be the winning move, but must be justified
transformed_for_job: ship loadout -> debut plan derived from the practice record (expectation gate scales with it)
live crises -> crowd/noise slots + stress signs; levers counter DIFFERENT pressures; stop ladder enforced
debut_plan.why_it_is_fun: a tense little ops sim: watch the cub, pick the right lever, dare to stop
debut_plan.what_requires_skill: record-to-plan translation + pressure-matched lever choice + stop timing
debut_plan.why_replay: temperament and events re-randomize; perfect = fitting plan with calm day or justified early stop
debut_plan.trace: welfare-first ops -> plan-then-adapt principle -> plan_then_adapt + event_response -> plan sliders + per-slot actions -> cub drifts to hide box, sign lamps light, crowd icons -> lever-matching mastery
